verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 gives agents an isolated cloud computer rather than running code on the user's host (docs-1). Its credential features authenticate outbound traffic without placing raw secret material inside the sandbox process (docs-15), and outbound traffic is controlled by SandboxNetworkPolicy (docs-13). Together these directly address keeping secrets out of reach of agent-run code. Missing for 10: detail on how credential injection and isolation boundaries work, and independent or hands-on verification that secrets are truly unreachable.
